findings: The historical diagnosis is real: exact b3eb1bcbd138314ece69a0b23ea2191b19008b79 removes factory viability. PSystemBuilder constructor tries Sequence before Class before Description; createPSystem accepts the first successful complete factory. ClassDiagramFactory registers shared containers, native declarations, body-owning commands, and both NORMAL_KEYWORD and WITH_MIX_PREFIX description commands. Candidate provenance identifies these classes correctly, but a keyword blacklist is not equivalent to their executable grammar.

Direct mechanism counterexample: label_plain passes the strict CLI comparator; label_bracket changes only the quoted class display to "North as [Cache]" and Rust selects Deployment, omitting Cache, while Java still selects ClassDiagram. native_class_container_candidate uses rest.contains(" as [") inside quoted text, contrary to NameAndCodeParser.nameAndCodeForClassWithGeneric. This disproves label independence without relying on geometry tolerances.

Direct ownership counterexample: header_left is valid Java ClassDiagram, but Rust chooses Component and materializes the header text "component journal" as a component while losing the class. The helper recognizes keyword header only; Java CommandMultilinesHeader accepts left/right/center header and owns the body. header_plain and header_left_text select Class, isolating the alignment/text interaction. Their remaining coordinate mismatches are separate rendering residue.

Native grammar remains incomplete: declaration_static, declaration_visible and their multiline variants all produce Java ClassDiagram but Rust Deployment. CommandCreateClass and CommandCreateClassMultilines allow static class and an optional visibility character. The scan sees static or +class rather than a native command and does not own their bodies. These were also failing before this candidate; they are unresolved relevant mechanism counterexamples, not claimed newly introduced regressions.

Source-to-product audit: CLI main -> parse_block/parse_auto_with_base -> preprocessing -> detect_uml_subtype -> one selected parser -> render_svg_with_theme. There is no retry of real parser command viability. ClassParser.parse_line silently ignores unknown lines. case_tabs selects Class after the change but drops ClAsS Cache; tabs_lower passes. native_record selects Class but drops the record. mix_prefix selects Class but drops Endpoint. The scan advertises case-insensitive/native grammar that the downstream parser does not consume.

Both forward and reverse non-package container aliases are valid under Java CommandPackageWithUSymbol. Rust selects Class for alias_forward and alias_reverse but ClassParser.try_package rejects non-package aliases or fails reverse grammar; the resulting AST has no packages, and the entire container disappears. This is a known pre-existing parser/model defect, not a cloud geometry discrepancy. The account scope limit does not authorize acceptance while these relevant held-out cases fail.

Execution-order rejection is not durable: the helper returns false on an early description leaf, but the unchanged score dispatcher sees a later allowmixing and forces Class. ClassParser.try_meta merely consumes allowmixing and try_entity_decl accepts component without an ordered mixing state. The preserved maker mixing_late negative still exits 0 as Class before and after, while its Java reference is an error page. This is existing end-to-end residue; the helper-only execution-order test does not prove the claimed invariant. No new malformed negative was devised, and this existing negative is preserved outside the valid-reference perturbation suite with its error reference clearly identified.
